title: The Primal Enemy
subtitle: Secrets, Shadows, and Smuggled Firearms Await
summary: A routine visit from the streetwise Bantul draws detective Byomkesh Bakshi into a web of secrets and illicit dealings in post-war Calcutta. When whispers of hidden weapons and shifting alliances surface, Byomkesh must untangle a mystery where danger lurks closer than ever. Can he uncover the truth before the shadows close in?
